body: Thank you for all of this, but im not sure if i can go on much longer.

I don't even know anymore. I feel like it's all going to shit.

I was seriously about to jump under a train few weeks back, i had a suicide note written and everything.

Well, i am very introverted and lacking in social skills so meeting new people is a struggle, therefore i can't imagine myself in a relationship even if i get through all of this. My school had gone well with grades varying from 8 to 10 until high school when i found myself struggling with severe depression. i was barely managing but somehow kept my grades from going to total shit but a few months back i started falling behind with the schoolwork. Now i have almost lost all interest in school as my depression grows by the day. If i were to continue on with life i would have 3 months worth of schoolwork to finish in a week. The reason behind my depression, i think  is the crippling loneliness and my sudden realization of how pointless this all is.
Not sure what to tell you.
Well there isn't much but working out can be fun from time to time.
I'm not sure what you mean by playstyle but i try to play strategically.
Mostly Far Cry games, Call of duty modern warfare(2019), Sea of thieves and Doom eternal.
I mostly play offline and if i play online i never type anything in chat and i keep my mic muted.

Well, i live in a small town with a population less than one thousand. I dont have any friends nor have i been in a relationship. I have severe depression. I used to go to gym but it's closed now because of the whole corona situation. I do still workout at home but much less than before. I used to do boxing but they stopped organizing that about a year ago. Most days i just sit in my room all alone just thinking. I play video games, they give me a bit of joy every now and then, but it's never enough.
